description: What each main-hosted lane in .github/workflows/main.yml runs, by phase (step) and test class, and which steps cover each class on a trusted pull request. tools/ci_coverage_contract.py checks a trusted pull request's receipts against it; //tools:ci_lane_parity_tests keeps it in step with the workflow. A class with no pull request counterpart carries a reviewed exception that names its owner and the decision behind it. A lane is checked only when its route says self-hosted jobs replaced its hosted job on the pull request.

cloud-build.description: A cold compile on the cloud executor, then the whole tree built with main's cloud execution configuration. The hosted job runs this step on trusted pull requests as well.

native.description: The selected targets, built by the self-hosted ARM64 lane.

hosted-toolchain.description: Main's hosted toolchain: the declared LLVM toolchain for x86_64, with the cloud execution that main's Build step uses, built for the whole tree on the hosted job before merge.

native.description: The selected tests, run by the self-hosted ARM64 lane.

local-display.description: Tests that need the hosted runner's Xvfb display.

hosted-parity.description: `hosted_parity` tests, whose result can depend on the runner: they must also run on the hosted x86_64 image.

exception.reason: Trusted pull requests run every other test only on the self-hosted ARM64 lane, for speed; only `hosted_parity` tests also run on the hosted image.

metal-validation.description: The self-hosted lane requires full Metal validation instead of selecting a profile.

exception.reason: By default, trusted pull requests run the macOS Build step only on the self-hosted lane, with the same pinned Xcode, so a build failure specific to the hosted image's other host tools (Command Line Tools, Homebrew) can first show on main.

native.description: The selected tests, run by the self-hosted fast lane.

hosted-parity.description: `hosted_parity` tests, rerun under the hosted runner's constraints.

exception.reason: To keep pull request runtime short, only the `hosted_parity` subset and the Geode editor lane rerun with main's hosted Bazel scheduling configuration; every other test runs only at the fast lane's full width. No pull request lane reproduces the hosted runner's CPU speed, GPU, memory or disk.

browser.description: Browser tests, run on the hosted image by the macos-browser subset.
